0022600101.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (1-0, 2nd in the Southwest, 5th in the West) visit the Golden State Warriors (0-1, 3rd in the Pacific, 13th in the West) in their second game of the season, and the Grizzlies are looking to build on a home win with a road win. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis was swept 0-3 by Golden State in 2025-26, including a 133-112 loss in Memphis on February 25, 2026. Isaiah Stewart (ankle) is day-to-day for Memphis and is a game-time decision, while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandin Podziemski (back soreness) and Charles Bassey (knee) are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
